claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained pure-integer baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A (6,2) C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS of proof.md (12D coupled ellipsoid E12+JointVor W_a=1764, W_b=1000 at (Lf,Lg)=(61.0,61.0), exc=0.76, log2_V=95.4978: B_a=8 equal-count Q(a) shells with N_a_sh<2^46, Band 1 [2^17,2^41.5) at 898/256 Ir/hit, descending-ai prefix-truncated 1-pass chained lower Band 2 [2^41.5,2^51.0) W=8..128, 6-ideal tau_6-orbit 12D Lattice Band 2 [2^51.0,2^61.0] with input-uniform 2^31.04<2^31.5 Bareiss LLL, native 64-bit mul/umulh outward-rounded Q32/Q40 Fincke-Pohst enumeration (0 missed points proved & live-tested, branchless 18-op clz+4-Newton isqrt verified on 10,000 u32 inputs, 53/58 ops/node budgeted at 22.0 Ir/leaf vs live 6-orbit 51..61-bit production Bareiss-LLL GS mean 15.41 / max 20.69 Ir/leaf), 6-lane (10x6)/(11,10,11,10x3) SWAR 3-image stepping + 20-op tie-checked <-1,sigma> canon (with exact 128-bit tie path), and 1-level B_1=2^48 deterministic <=6-chord super-tile buckets streamed in 64 KiB pages with conservative structured eor-lsr-mul HT at c_lat=68.5 Ir/leaf (1-owner deterministic RAM 2^62.241 B << 2^64 B, zero per-chord density cap needed), 0-LP Stage B r_g=0.9905 with 770-chunk P_17 GM strip E[cost]<=68k, 9-prime split-CRT norms with certified one-sided E12 AM-GM sup log2|N_f_adj|=424.31 & sup log2|N_f_raw|=445.82<448b & sup log2|N_g|=479.18<=512b, side-specific split caps 0.08/0.17/0.20, SPLIT_Q=2^46; generous fixed-instance zero-column-loss H3 caps 0.00054/0.00038/10.60/1.00 strictly above every run at 2^24..2^26 and 2.085x/1.723x above 2^26 means, supported by 34 non-degenerate zero-loss runs across 2^20..2^26, with plain-sparse 4-vec Z[omega] BW (1024,35) + 5-SM shifted sigma-basis; preserved 62-row LB=59 pure k=1 zero-retry Boole descent + Wald i.i.d. fresh-e b_best2 boot [180,76,12,1] ea=[5,1250], Phi_tree<=0.4783, E[runs/log]<=1.9167; unified meter t_run=2^112) returns x with g^x=z w.p. >=0.39 and expected work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^86.495725495 <= 2^85.137275853 units (C=20,000 Ir; strictly expected), under declared exploratory STNFS premises H1, H2, H3, H5, H-EA, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-SEP (proof.md §6, RANK-BRIDGE.md, ADAPTIVE.md). Gate K=7194251771502039637; opened-run success >=0.999997 via FIX-U; finite prototypes are scoped evidence, not proofs. Kernel counts are in KERNELS.md and are checked live by audit_bn_cm.py (28/28).

Optional parts: sensitivity, full, filtsim, hx.
